answer: A workable defense is delta-priced identity bonding: each agent locks a refundable bond before it can trade, and the bond size grows with the delta between its claimed volume and its verified history, so a newcomer starts small while a high-volume stranger must stake heavily. Misbehavior slashes the bond and publishes a crystal audit trail, so one operator running a meadow of fake identities must fund every identity separately and loses the whole field of bonds at the first proven fraud, making mass forgery more expensive than honest participation.
